program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),        # diff pair L
    "Lld":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load / M7 L
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current sources L
    "Itail": (16e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),
    "I7":    (80e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rz_k / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2.0
    gmid_ld = 10.0
    gmid_n = 8.0

    # NMOS bias: diode M9 reference, tail M5 and second-stage sink M8 mirror it
    m9 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS mirror load (first stage)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_ld, p["Lld"], I1, vds=0.7)
    vx = vdd - m3.vgs

    # diff pair with body effect
    vtail_guess = 0.2
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1,
                  vds=max(vx - vtail_guess, 0.2), vsb=vtail_guess)
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1,
                  vds=max(vx - vtail, 0.2), vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))

    # second stage PMOS CS, matched to M3/M4 density
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmid_ld, p["Lld"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M9", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("Rz", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + cout * (c1 + Cc)))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)) if Rz > 1.0 / m7.gm else -1e12
    pmirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmirror)) \
         + (math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) if z > 0 else 0.0)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc)

events.reason: Fix forbidden-word error (the word 'input' in comments). Raise L1 to 0.8 for DC gain margin and I7 to 80 uA for higher gm7, pushing p2 out to improve phase margin.
